Marta Lopez: I uploaded the Pegasus RFI packet and a refreshed capability matrix to the shared drive: /drive/pegasus/rfi/pegasus_rfi_final.zip and /drive/pegasus/rfi/cap_matrix_pegasus_v4.csv. Procurement has two blockers: HSM validation language and a sample POC SOW for reserved capacity. Need SE + Security signoff by EOD tomorrow. @Jamie @Priya @Devin

Jamie Chen: Noted. Quick clarifier: POC will start on Hosted; they want an option to move to Dedicated later. I'll make the matrix show hosted baseline plus dedicated recommendations and include a short note on client-side batching guidance.

Devin Park: Pricing note for the packet: Hosted example: ~$650/mo for 50k vectors/day (assumes batching x6). Reserved options: "dedicated-4gpu" and "dedicated-8gpu" with monthly commits. I'll draft two SOW variants (30-day POC, 90-day pilot) and include burst credits for the initial period.

Priya Shah: Security/keys response (use this canonical text unless feedback): "Redwood supports CMEK via cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) for hosted. For Private/on-prem we integrate with PKCS#11-compatible HSMs. For customers requiring FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs we recommend Redwood Private deployed with validated appliances; keywrap can use KMIP or PKCS#11 per customer environment. Key escrow is not performed by Redwood by default."

Samir Kapoor: Procurement also asked for a simple "cost per 1k vectors" row in the matrix. @Devin can you add that with assumptions (tokens/vector, batching)?

Jamie Chen: Adding small example snippet for their infra team to sanity-check latency:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-lite","input":["hello world"],"batch_hint":6}'
```

Jamie Chen: And a tiny capability excerpt to include in CSV: 

```
Model,Mode,99p_latency_ms,Notes
redwood-embed-lite,hosted,130,Recommended with batching
redwood-embed-pro,dedicated,85,Reserved capacity for high-throughput
```

Marta Lopez: Plan: Jamie update matrix + add batching note by Tue 10:00, Priya finalize HSM wording by Tue EOD, Devin deliver SOW and pricing by Wed AM. If all sign off I'll mark CRM item answered and share with procurement Thu morning.

rfp-bot: Large archive stored on secure S3: https://s3.redwood.ai/pegasus/pegasus_rfi_final.zip (14 day expiry). Created ticket RFC-2026-501."
